A1.justification: Both complete, readable 24-page PDFs describe the same CALM-DT work. All text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-H support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendices D and F-H report original CF-registry experiments, NSCLC simulations, ecological evaluations, and ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including medical and ecological evaluations and ablations in Tables 2-11.

M1.justification: The retrieval procedure, prompt formulation, generation loop, encoder fine-tuning, and trajectory-summary components in Section 4 and Appendix A are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same CF and NSCLC scenarios, Ivacaftor adaptation, ecological population dynamics, and untreated-NSCLC event timing, including appendix experiments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 2 and 8-10. Appendix E retains the same baseline implementations.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices C and F-H retain identical data splits, sample sizes, training settings, simulation horizons, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures.

E4.justification: The CF and NSCLC sample-selection ablations, base-LLM comparisons, context-size analyses, and drug-name substitution check are unchanged, including their appendix documentation.

E5.justification: Tables 2-11 retain the same repeated-run counts and 95% confidence interval reporting. No statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, rankings, and qualitative findings match, including Tables 2-11 and Figure 3. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The system and modelling-environment definitions in Section 2, retrieval formulation in Section 4, and InfoNCE equations (1)-(2) are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain identical claims about CALM-DT's performance, context-adaptive simulation, and adaptation without parameter updates.

C2.justification: The experimental interpretations, Section 7.1 limitations, and Appendix H explanation of the interaction between summaries and encoder fine-tuning are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, prompt examples, data preparation, hyperparameters, model/API specifications, and baseline-code access information in Appendices A-C and E are identical.

R1.justification: Section 5, research positioning, and cited works are unchanged. Bibliography entries move across page boundaries but none are added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgements section on page 9 stating that Canon Medical Systems Corporation funds Harry Amad's studentship. The arXiv version/date annotation also changes; the research narrative is otherwise identical.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement shifts the References heading downward and reflows bibliography text across pages 9-14. Figures, tables, and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and slightly reflows the references. This provides additional disclosure, but the scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and readability remain effectively unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
